actual_reading: It will not be disputed that by virtue of that authority the President had power to issue his proclamation of general amnesty. But disputes may arise on other questions connected with this proclamation. What was the condition upon which the pardon was to inure to the benefit of the party pardoned? It was first that he should file the oath named and in the manner to be prescribed. But this is not of itself sufficient.
